hypothesis: All 124 measured calls returned before hashing. Their cost should be approximately constant across token counts; including token count exposes the distinct entry states hidden by the previous all-zero predictors.

pcvs.name: num_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes entry states within the observed early-return path, allowing its approximately constant instruction cost to be evaluated across sufficient states.

pcvs.name: new_full_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Retains the actual loop-work predictor for any entry with full blocks remaining to hash.
